description: In the status readout, the token count opens the cost popup and the model name opens the picker. The screen is 1280x800. "The tokens" is ".context-usage-label"; "the model" is ".model-picker-inline .p-select-label"; "the cost popup" is ".chat-context-popup"; "the picker panel" is ".model-picker-panel". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The tokens (allow 30s) and the model should be visible. 3. Click the tokens: the cost popup should be visible and contain "LLM call", and there must be no picker panel (count 0). 4. Press Escape: the cost popup should be hidden. 5. Click the model: the picker panel should be visible, as should its first ".p-select-option" and its ".model-picker-effort-pills"; the cost popup should be hidden. 6. Press Escape: the picker panel should be hidden.
